items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: but Joe Jones kind of had me spoiled

ctx.x: over and everything and he asked me if I had anybody in the band who can't be fired? And I said no, but why do you ask that. He said, well, you know, a lot of you bands are doing all right but you can always use improvement. The next thing was, are you signed up with anybody? I said no. He said I just can't understand how somebody hasn't signed a band like you. He said, what I was thinking is I'll go and sign you, then somebody that signed a contract two years ago or something and hadn't done anything would come…

thing though, I like the group, but Joe Jones kind of had me spoiled. He said when he dropped into New York way, he was kicking that Count Basie band, he says, we just hadn't had any drummers kicking no band like that unless it was Chick Webb that just kicked (inaudible).
